title: CNN detects small Strombolian eruptions in infrared images of Erebus lava lake
summary: A CNN trained on more than 54,000 denoised multitemporal infrared images of the Erebus lava lake classified images as no, small or large eruption. On the held-out test set it reached a macro F1 of 0.9782 and MCC of 0.9397, and it detected small eruptions below the limits of conventional automated methods. The study covers one volcano with partly curated labels.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network on denoised multitemporal infrared images

evidence.tested: Held-out test performance and temporal generalisation to later images after a change in lake morphology.
evidence.unknown: Single volcano; labels partly curated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: CNN classifying thermal image sequences by eruption size.
